title: OpenAI presents three results in harmonic analysis, complexity, and quantum theory
summary: OpenAI announces results on local smoothing, a disproof of the exponential time hypothesis, and the construction of quantum field theories. The source presents these as research results to be understood with academic groups: physical artifacts are not yet public, and independent verification is not established here.

evidence.tested: The local-smoothing proof was formalized in Lean the day after the AI output; the refutation of the Exponential Time Hypothesis was verified in Lean and is being checked by an external group led by Impagliazzo, Paturi and Williams.
evidence.unknown: The physics result was not released; the external groups had not reported conclusions on the page.
evidence.ai_role: OpenAI internal models produced the proofs; external experts were asked to shepherd and explain the results.
